:new: New project intention · #42 Formalizing Roth's theorem in Diophantine approximation

Ongoing project with @rtakloo on formalizing Roth's theorem in Diophantine approximation.

This should be achievable entirely through autoformalization, but our goal is to develop a high-quality formalization with substantial human-written code, and eventually contribute it to Mathlib.
